hints.title: Fuel Consumption Steps
hints.text: Consume fuel from the main tank in chunks of 5 liters.

hints.title: Reserve Fuel Transfer
hints.text: Each time 5 liters are burned, transfer 1 liter from the additional tank if available.

hints.title: Remaining Fuel Mileage
hints.text: Multiply all consumed liters by 10 kilometers per liter.

hints.title: Simulation Code

variables: mainTank: initial liters in main tank
complexity.notes: Simulates fuel drainage in steps of 5 liters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring the 1-liter replenishment condition undercounts total distance.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models fuel depletion and replenishment accurately.
